answer: Fraud's kernel demand is the same everywhere: large value, instantly. Tier custody by temperature. Small actions ride copper-fast hot paths with light attestation; large ones cool in a vault path - a soak window plus a deep, slow quorum, with cooling time scaling by value so the fast lane and big lane never merge. Clone fleets optimize burst-and-drain, but burst-size packages always land in the cold tier, where their short lives cannot wait out the soak. Honest agents rarely need speed at size; their fortunes mature at vault pace anyway.
